en: Changed Claude Code on Bedrock, Mantle, Vertex, and Foundry to load model settings from a signed file on downloads.claude.ai; set CLAUDE\_CODE\_MODEL\_CATALOG=off to turn this off
zh: 变更 Bedrock、Mantle、Vertex 和 Foundry 上的 Claude Code，改为从 downloads.claude.ai 上的签名文件加载模型设置；设置 CLAUDE\_CODE\_MODEL\_CATALOG=off 可关闭此功能
